subject: A review note covers the migration. A ship rollback note says rollback is alembi
source: Reviewed alembic/versions/d4e7a2b81c05_dedupe_transactions.py. Upgrade deletes extra transactions that share (account_id, pluggy_transaction_id), then extra rows that share (account_id, description, amount, transaction_date), keeping the oldest id. Amounts match after quantizing to cents. It then adds uq_transactions_account_pluggy_id with batch_alter_table so SQLite and Postgres both apply. Downgrade drops that constraint and does not restore deleted rows. No other table is changed.
